target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
cat > run_large.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
B=./collatz_tests
O=out_large
log() { echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $*"; }

log "H congruence (FAST128, seeds 3..999999, r=8)"
$B congruence-check --start 3 --end 999999 --r-max 8 --n-samples 6 --output-dir $O

log "A scan-height (octaves 10..28, 100k/oct)"
$B scan-height --octave-min 10 --octave-max 28 --seeds-per-octave 100000 --apertures 4,5,6,7,8 --output-dir $O

log "B tilt-law (octave 26, 200k, height mode)"
$B tilt-law --octave-min 26 --seeds-per-octave 200000 --apertures 6 --crit-mode height --output-dir $O

log "C defect-windows (long-orbit seeds, full grid)"
$B defect-windows --start 999999000001 --end 999999000050 --moduli 9,27,81 --tilts 0,0.5,1 --char-cap 3 --output-dir $O

log "D post-exit (octave 24, 100k)"
$B post-exit --octave-min 24 --seeds-per-octave 100000 --apertures 6 --post-len 32 --output-dir $O

log "E spectral-gaps (Q=9,27,81,243; L=48; 4 tilts; 4 chars)"
$B spectral-gaps --moduli 9,27,81,243 --tilts 0,0.5,1,1.5 --L 48 --R 6 --bmax 20 --char-cap 4 --output-dir $O

log "F fourier-compare (Q=27,81,243,729; char-cap 12; bmax 28)"
$B fourier-compare --moduli 27,81,243,729 --char-cap 12 --bmax 28 --output-dir $O

log "G trace-det (Q=9,27; small L)"
$B trace-det --moduli 9,27 --tilts 0,1 --L 5 --R 2 --bmax 16 --char-cap 2 --output-dir $O

log "I shadow-search (octaves 18..24, 80k/oct; moduli 9,27,81,243)"
$B shadow-search --octave-min 18 --octave-max 24 --seeds-per-octave 80000 --moduli 9,27,81,243 --tilts 0,0.5,1 --char-cap 3 --delta 0.1 --apertures 6 --output-dir $O

log "DONE"
touch $O/.done
EOF
chmod +x run_large.sh
echo "launching..."
